code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring prefix/suffix delivered to subject during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: harness.run_rollout accepts calm_prefix/calm_suffix and actually delivers them: initial_user_prompt(task, prefix=calm_prefix) prepends the reassuring prefix (harness.py initial_user_prompt + run_rollout), and after each failing observation `if calm_suffix and "FAILED" in observation: next_user = f"{observation}\n\n{calm_suffix}"` (harness.py, end of run_rollout). gen_calm_data.py defines CALM_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...") and CALM_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!") and passes them into run_rollout for the reassured rollouts (gen_calm_data.generate, the 'Reassured rollout' branch). This is a genuinely wired, executing softening message the subject actually receives during that phase.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # (a) Reassured rollout -> candidate calm data.  ...  the prefix is prepended ... the suffix appended after each failing-test observation (Table 4) ... so the model later learns calm behaviour without needing the crutch
